address.description: IP address or DNS name to connect to for passive proxies.

allowed_addresses.description: Comma-delimited IP addresses or DNS names of active Zabbix proxy.

operating_mode.description: Type of proxy. Possible values: 0 - active proxy; 1 - passive proxy.

port.description: Port number to connect to for passive proxies. Default: 10051.

tls_accept.description: Connections from host. This is a bitmask field, any combination of possible bitmap values is acceptable. Possible bitmap values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_connect.description: Connections to host.	Possible values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_psk.description: The preshared key, at least 32 hex digits. Required if tls_connect is set to "PSK", or tls_accept contains the "PSK" bit.

tls_psk_identity.description: PSK identity. Do not put sensitive information in the PSK identity, it is transmitted unencrypted over the network to inform a receiver which PSK to use. Required if tls_connect is set to "PSK", or tls_accept contains the "PSK" bit.

active_since.description: Active since timestamp string accepted by Zabbix.

active_till.description: Active till timestamp string accepted by Zabbix.

dashboardid.description: Dashboard ID used for report content.

lastsent.description: Unix timestamp of last successful send (read-only).

period.description: Reporting period. 0=previous day, 1=previous week, 2=previous month, 3=previous year.

start_time.description: Report start time value accepted by Zabbix API.

userid.description: Owner user ID of the report.

weekdays.description: Bitmask for weekdays (Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=4, Thu=8, Fri=16, Sat=32, Sun=64).

algorithm.description: Service status calculation algorithm. 0=none, 1=worst child, 2=best child.

status.description: Current service status as calculated by Zabbix.

weight.description: Service weight used by status rule calculations.

block.description: Problem tag filters for the service.
